subject: EdgeTrack onboarding: cost & performance tuning plan
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@edgetrack.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@edgetrack.io>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: EdgeTrack onboarding & cost/perf alignment

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Before our formal kickoff, we want to align on the cost/performance workstream so execs understand the deployment economics. Key asks from our side:

- A short implementation plan that covers batching, prefix/KV caching strategy, and recommended quantization profile(s) for our first-served LLM workload.
- Routing policy options (latency-first vs cost-first fallbacks) and how they impact p99 latency and token cost.
- Example timeline and resource commitments (hand-off points between Redwood CS and our infra/dev teams).

I attached a sample KPI export (edgetrack_kpi_sample.csv) that shows our request/response size distributions. We also need an initial SOW to route to Procurement. Can you share Redwood's onboarding template and a proposed 3-week plan?

Proposed kickoff window: Thu 20 Mar, 10–11am PT. Does that work for you?

Thanks — Amelia
Amelia Torres
Director, Platform Engineering
EdgeTrack

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@edgetrack.io>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@edgetrack.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: EdgeTrack onboarding & cost/perf alignment

Hi Amelia — great to hear and thanks for the KPI export. Thu 20 Mar 10am PT works for us; I'll send a calendar invite in a minute.

Attached: redwood_onboard_config_template.pdf (template SOW + config checklist). High-level plan below — I kept it short so Procurement has something to review immediately and our teams have clear handoffs.

3-week onboarding sprint (proposed)
1) Week 0 — Prep (this week)
  - Share KPI & code access (EdgeTrack)
  - Redwood provides onboarding template + initial quant/caching recommendations
2) Week 1 — Ingest & Baseline
  - Quick integration: test tokenization, baseline latency/cost runs, capture KV hit curve
  - Deliverable: baseline report, sample traces
3) Week 2 — Tune Phase
  - Batching policy experiments (micro-batches, dynamic batch sizing)
  - KV/prefix caching configuration and eviction policy tuning
  - Quantization profile validation (FP16 -> 8-bit/4-bit candidates) with quality checks on your eval set
4) Week 3 — Harden + Handover
  - Finalize routing policy (latency-first with cost-tier fallback suggested)
  - Run 48h soak test; prepare runbook and rollback plan
  - Deliverables: tuned config, performance/cost dashboard, SOW for production handoff

Initial roles & asks
- EdgeTrack: provide API keys, representative prompt set, and baseline traffic replay (you sent KPI export — thanks).
- Redwood CS (me): own orchestration of experiments and deliver tuning recommendations.
- Redwood infra (cc Laura): will own deployment templates and tracing hooks for logs.

Action items before Thu kickoff:
- I will attach the onboarding template now (redwood_onboard_config_template.pdf).
- Please confirm we can get a short replay of 1–2 hours of production-like traffic for baseline runs.

Looking forward to the kickoff — I'll include a meeting agenda and calendar invite.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_onboard_config_template.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2025 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: EdgeTrack onboarding & cost/perf alignment

Team — forwarding Amelia's note. EdgeTrack wants a tight 3-week plan focused on batching/caching/quant and a routing policy recommendation. Proposed split:

- Karthik: lead quantization profile selection and offline quality validation. Deliverable: two candidate profiles (s8 and q4/32) with token-cost delta and top-line quality delta by end of Week 2. Estimate: 3 engineer-days.
- Sean: lead routing & cache policy experiments (prefix/KV hit target, eviction policy). Deliverable: recommended routing table + cache knobs; coordinate on traces. Estimate: 4 engineer-days.
- Laura: infra/deploy templates and observability (tracing hooks, token-level cost breakdowns). Deliverable: deployment manifest + dashboard.

Technical asks from EdgeTrack that we should confirm during kickoff:
- Access pattern: sync vs streaming; average prompt length; p99 request size (we have KPI csv).
- Acceptable quality drop threshold for each quant profile (suggest <=2% BLEU-equivalent on eval set).
- Any constraints on on-prem vs hosted routing (they indicated cloud-first).

I'll add a short internal checklist to the shared Drive. Please reply with when you can start experiments; aim to have initial baselines done by Fri EOD so we can show numbers at the kickoff.

- Deliverables: tuned config bundle, performance & cost dashboard, SOW for production handoff (DocuSign link below).

Immediate asks for Procurement

- Redwood: run baseline latency/cost and provide first-pass quant candidates by Fri 21 Mar.
